Julio Ángel Fernández Alves (born 5 April 1946) is a Uruguayan astronomer and teacher, member of the department of astronomy at the Universidad de la República

Julio Ángel Fernández Alves (born 5 April 1946) [1] is a Uruguayan astronomer and teacher, member of the department of astronomy at the Universidad de la República in Montevideo. [2] He is also a member of PEDECIBA, (the program for development of basic sciences in Uruguay), [3] and the Uruguayan Society of Astronomy. [4] From 2005 to 2010, he was the Dean of the Universidad de la Republica
